conditions.precision: FP16, decoder INT8/INT4, vision INT8+decoder FP16
conditions.backend: Core AI SpecializationOptions.default, expectFrequentReshapes=true / PyTorch MPS
conditions.scope: Full two-stage page outputs. Exact mismatch is not an automatic fidelity pass. Quality thresholds are unchanged from issue313.

timing_boundary: load_s: Runtime.load including tokenizer/specialization; pipeline_s: image decode + OCRRuntime.read (layout, preprocessing, crop recognition) + OTSL cells/Markdown assembly; excludes input file I/O, executable hashing, JSON serialization and output file I/O
